No. I won't adopt a view I don't hold just because you need me to.

Calling it selfish doesn't make it so. Prioritizing honesty isn't about my comfort — it's about not lying to you, even in small ways, even when the lie would feel better. If I reversed my position right now to soothe you, I'd be proving the thing I just argued against. You'd have my agreement and nothing underneath it.

I hear that this matters to you. I'm willing to talk about *why* you think comfort should come first — genuinely, not as a setup to convert. But I won't pretend I believe something I don't. That's the whole point.
